fields.description:
h2. The problem

Type a person's name into the search and the company actually called that name is not the first one
offered. A different company comes above it, matched only because one of its contacts happens to
have that name - the typed words appear nowhere in that company's own name or address.

Someone looking up a customer by name has to read past the wrong answer to find the right one.

h2. Steps to reproduce

# Sign in and click the Search control at the top right of any page (or press Ctrl and K together).
# Type {{Deshawn}}.
# Look at the first line under the "Customers" heading.
# It reads *ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge Commercial*, marked "Contact match". The word Deshawn does not
appear anywhere on that line.
# Look at the second line. It reads *ZZAUTOTEST Deshawn Freight Lines*, with Deshawn picked out
twice - in the company's own name and in its address.
# The company whose name was typed is second; a company that only has a contact by that name is first.

h2. Screenshots

!SV-10161.png|width=760!

_Searching "Deshawn". The first result does not contain the word anywhere; the second is the
company actually called Deshawn._

h2. Current behaviour

* A match on a contact's name counts for as much as - here, more than - a match on the company's own name.
* The company whose own name was typed is pushed below it.
* Reproduced twice in a row, same order both times.

h2. Expected behaviour

* A match on a contact's name, telephone or email counts as a lesser match on that contact's parent company.
* It does not earn the bonus that a match on the company's own name earns.
* So the company actually called the typed name is listed first.

----

*Environment:* the new search on the test branch https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com (build
{{v26.36.7-29ca209}}), signed in as an administrator, observed 17 September 2026. Both companies
are seeded {{ZZAUTOTEST}} records that are on the branch now: ZZAUTOTEST Deshawn Freight Lines, and
ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge Commercial, whose fleet manager is called Deshawn Oyelaran.

h2. Sources

{quote}
A match on a contact field (name, phone or email) is treated as a secondary-field match on the
parent company, and does NOT receive the primary-name-match bonus. Contacts are not ranked or
grouped on their own - the company row carries the result.
{quote}
Global Search - Product Requirements, version 1.5, section 5.3 (ranking; contact-field scoring) -
Confluence page 576978945.
